# Hospital Healthcare Europe

> > Hospital Healthcare Europe delivers clinical news, research insights, and evidence-based analysis on emerging treatments and healthcare policy across Europe.

Hospital Healthcare Europe is a clinical news and research platform covering dermatology, oncology, cardiovascular medicine, and healthcare policy with a focus on regulatory approvals (MHRA, NICE), drug innovations (JAK inhibitors, monoclonal antibodies), and healthcare professional insights. The site aggregates clinical trials, expert views, and country-specific healthcare profiles across European healthcare systems.

## Key Topics

- JAK inhibitors
- NICE guidance
- MHRA approvals
- Clinical trials
- Dermatology
- Oncology
- Cardiovascular medicine
- Healthcare policy
- Patient outcomes
- Risk stratification
- Drug approvals
- European healthcare
- NHS
- Clinical research
- Healthcare professionals

## Clinical News & Drug Approvals

- [Deuruxolitinib approved by MHRA for severe alopecia areata](https://hospitalhealthcare.com/clinical/dermatology/deuruxolitinib-approved-by-mhra-for-severe-alopecia-areata): MHRA approval of JAK inhibitor deuruxolitinib for alopecia areata treatment
- [Ruxolitinib approved by NICE for non-segmental vitiligo](https://hospitalhealthcare.com/clinical/dermatology/ruxolitinib-approved-by-nice-for-non-segmental-vitiligo): NICE approval of topical JAK inhibitor ruxolitinib for vitiligo treatment
- [Bimekizumab shows sustained psoriasis treatment benefits](https://hospitalhealthcare.com/clinical/dermatology/bimekizumab-shows-sustained-patient-benefits-in-psoriasis-extension-study): BE RADIANT extension study on bimekizumab efficacy in psoriasis
- [Baxdrostat evidence for resistant hypertension control](https://hospitalhealthcare.com/clinical/cardiovascular/more-evidence-for-baxdrostat-effectively-controlling-resistant-hypertension): Clinical trial evidence for baxdrostat in resistant hypertension treatment

## Oncology & Cancer Screening

- [NHS mammogram attendance reaches decade high with early diagnoses](https://hospitalhealthcare.com/clinical/oncology/first-nhs-mammogram-attendance-soars-to-decade-high-as-early-cancer-diagnoses-rise-yet-concerns-remain): NHS breast screening attendance and early cancer diagnosis trends analysis
- [AI-supported mammography screening shows improved cancer detection](https://hospitalhealthcare.com/clinical/oncology/ai-supported-mammography-screening-demonstrates-non-inferior-interval-cancer-rates): MASAI study on artificial intelligence in breast cancer screening performance
- [Baseline PSA levels predict long-term prostate cancer risk](https://hospitalhealthcare.com/clinical/oncology/baseline-psa-levels-linked-to-long-term-prostate-cancer-risk-in-population-study): Population study on PSA screening for prostate cancer risk stratification
- [Protecting HCPs from hazardous medical products safety campaign](https://hospitalhealthcare.com/clinical/oncology/protecting-hcps-from-hazardous-medical-products-subject-of-new-safety-campaign): Healthcare worker safety campaign for hazardous medical product handling

## Dermatology & Patient Health Outcomes

- [Mental health burden in vitiligo patients revealed in cohort study](https://hospitalhealthcare.com/clinical/dermatology/burden-of-mental-health-disorders-in-people-with-vitiligo-revealed-in-large-cohort-study): Large cohort study on depression and anxiety comorbidity in vitiligo
